# API

User-facing Image Factory HTTP, PXE, and OCI registry API.
Authentication requirements apply when an authentication provider is configured.

## Authentication

This Enterprise capability is controlled by the Image Factory configuration.
When it is disabled, authenticated endpoints are public, and the download-token endpoints are not registered.
When it is enabled, endpoints marked as required accept credentials described in [Authentication](authentication.md).

A download token is accepted only where the access table says so.
An Auth0 token carrying the configured machine scope is limited to operations marked as allowed.
Ownership indicates whether the authenticated identity is checked against the schematic owner.

## Edition and feature availability

Operations marked as Enterprise require [Enterprise Image Factory](https://docs.siderolabs.com/talos/latest/learn-more/enterprise-image-factory).
When the corresponding plugin is unavailable, its route is not registered or the operation returns the documented error.

### `POST /download-token`

Create a short-lived image download token

> [!NOTE]
> Enterprise route.

Issues a short-lived JWT for authenticated image downloads; the optional ttl query parameter requests its lifetime.

#### Access for `POST /download-token`

|Auth|`?token=`|Machine scope|Ownership|
|---|---|---|---|
|required|not accepted|denied|not-applicable|

#### Parameters for `POST /download-token`

|Name|In|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`ttl`|query|no|string|Requested positive Go duration; The issuer enforces its configured minimum and maximum; omitting this parameter selects the configured default; Example: `1h`.|

|Status|Description|Content types|Schemas|Headers|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`200`|A short-lived download token.|`application/json`|`DownloadToken`|`Cache-Control`|

### `POST /schematics`

Create or identify a schematic

Validates a YAML or JSON schematic, stores its canonical representation, and returns its deterministic identifier.
The body is decoded as YAML, which also accepts JSON, independently of the Content-Type header.

#### Access for `POST /schematics`

|Auth|`?token=`|Machine scope|Ownership|
|---|---|---|---|
|required|not accepted|denied|sets-owner|

#### Request body for `POST /schematics`

|Content type|Schema|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`*/*`|`Schematic`|yes|
|`application/json`|`Schematic`|yes|
|`application/yaml`|`Schematic`|yes|

#### Responses for `POST /schematics`

|Status|Description|Content types|Schemas|Headers|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`201`|The persisted canonical schematic and its ID.|`application/json`|`SchematicCreated`||
|`400`|Invalid input.|`text/plain`|string||
|`401`|**Enterprise.** Authentication is configured and credentials are missing or invalid.|`text/plain`|string|`WWW-Authenticate`|
|`403`|**Enterprise.** The authenticated principal is outside its scope or does not own the schematic.|`text/plain`|string||
|`500`|Unexpected server failure.|`text/plain`|string||

#### Parameters for `GET /pxe/{schematic}/{version}/{path}`

|Name|In|Required|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`schematic`|path|yes|string|SHA-256 identifier returned by `POST /schematics`; Example: `376567988ad370138ad8b2698212367b8edcb69b5fd68c80be1f2ec7d603b4ba`.|
|`version`|path|yes|string|Semantic Talos Linux version, accepted with or without the leading `v`; Example: `v1.13.0`.|
|`path`|path|yes|string|Artifact filename or platform-specific route suffix; Example: `metal-amd64.raw.xz`.|

#### Responses for `GET /pxe/{schematic}/{version}/{path}`

|Status|Description|Content types|Schemas|Headers|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`200`|Plain-text response.|`text/plain`|string||
|`400`|Invalid input.|`text/plain`|string||
|`401`|**Enterprise.** Authentication is configured and credentials are missing or invalid.|`text/plain`|string|`WWW-Authenticate`|
|`403`|**Enterprise.** The authenticated principal is outside its scope or does not own the schematic.|`text/plain`|string||
|`404`|The route or requested object does not exist.|`text/plain`|string||
|`500`|Unexpected server failure.|`text/plain`|string||

## Schemas

Reusable request and response schemas from the OpenAPI contract.

### `Customization`

Talos image build customizations.

Type: object

|Property|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|`bootloader`|string|no|Bootloader selection; `auto` lets the imager choose the appropriate bootloader; Allowed values: `auto`, `dual-boot`, `grub`, `sd-boot`; Default: `auto`.|
|`diskImage`|`DiskImageCustomization`|no|Options applied only when producing disk images.|
|`embeddedMachineConfiguration`|string|no|YAML-encoded Talos machine configuration documents embedded in the image.|
|`extraKernelArgs`|array<string>|no|Additional arguments appended to the kernel command line.|
|`meta`|array<`MetaValue`>|no|Initial Talos META key-value entries.|
|`secureboot`|`SecureBootCustomization`|no|Secure Boot options used when producing a Secure Boot image.|
|`systemExtensions`|`SystemExtensions`|no|Official Talos system extensions to install into the image.|

### `DiskImageCustomization`

Options applied only when producing disk images.

Type: object

|Property|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|`sectorSize`|integer|no|Disk-image sector size in bytes; An omitted or zero value uses 512 bytes; Default: `512`.|

### `DownloadToken`

> [!NOTE]
> Enterprise component.

Short-lived bearer token scoped to image downloads owned by the caller.

Type: object

|Property|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|`access_token`|string|yes|Signed JWT supplied through the image URL's `token` query parameter.|
|`expires_in`|integer (`int64`)|yes|Granted lifetime in seconds.|
|`token_type`|string|yes|OAuth-style token type.|

### `Extension`

An official system extension compatible with the requested Talos version.

Type: object

|Property|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|`author`|string|yes|Extension author from the catalog metadata.|
|`description`|string|yes|Human-readable purpose of the extension.|
|`digest`|string|yes|OCI content digest for the extension image; Pattern: `^[a-z0-9]+(?:[+._-][a-z0-9]+)*:[A-Za-z0-9=_-]+$`.|
|`name`|string|yes|Catalog name used in `officialExtensions`.|
|`ref`|string|yes|Immutable or versioned OCI image reference for the extension.|

Example:

```json
{
  "author": "Sidero Labs",
  "description": "AMD CPU microcode",
  "digest": "sha256:761a5290a4bae9ceca11468d2ba8ca7b0f94e6e3a107ede2349ae26520682832",
  "name": "siderolabs/amd-ucode",
  "ref": "ghcr.io/siderolabs/amd-ucode:20230804"
}
```

### `MetaValue`

Initial Talos META entry.

Type: object

|Property|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|`key`|integer|yes|Unsigned 8-bit META key.|
|`value`|string|yes|META value stored under the key.|

### `Overlay`

An official board overlay compatible with the requested Talos version.

Type: object

|Property|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|`digest`|string|yes|OCI content digest for the overlay image; Pattern: `^[a-z0-9]+(?:[+._-][a-z0-9]+)*:[A-Za-z0-9=_-]+$`.|
|`image`|string|yes|Overlay image name supplied in a schematic.|
|`name`|string|yes|Overlay name supplied in a schematic.|
|`ref`|string|yes|Versioned OCI image reference for the overlay.|

Example:

```json
{
  "digest": "sha256:849ace01b9af514d817b05a9c5963a35202e09a4807d12f8a3ea83657c76c863",
  "image": "siderolabs/sbc-raspberrypi",
  "name": "rpi_generic",
  "ref": "ghcr.io/siderolabs/sbc-raspberrypi:v0.1.0"
}
```

### `OverlayConfiguration`

Board overlay selected for image generation.

Type: object

|Property|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|`image`|string|yes|Overlay container image or catalog image name.|
|`name`|string|yes|Overlay implementation name.|
|`options`|object|no|Free-form options interpreted by the selected overlay implementation.|

### `Schematic`

Requested Talos image customization.
Unknown fields are rejected.

Type: object

|Property|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|`customization`|`Customization`|no|Talos image build customizations.|
|`overlay`|`OverlayConfiguration`|no|Board overlay selected for image generation.|
|`owner`|string|no|**Enterprise.** Enterprise-only owner identity; When authentication is enabled, the factory sets this to the authenticated identity and rejects a conflicting supplied value.|

Example:

```json
{
  "customization": {
    "extraKernelArgs": [
      "console=ttyS0"
    ],
    "meta": [
      {
        "key": 10,
        "value": "{\"externalIPs\":[\"1.2.3.4\"]}"
      }
    ],
    "systemExtensions": {
      "officialExtensions": [
        "siderolabs/amd-ucode"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### `SchematicCreated`

Canonical persisted schematic and its content-derived identifier.

Type: object

|Property|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|`id`|string|yes|SHA-256 digest of the canonical YAML schematic, encoded as lowercase hexadecimal; Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`.|
|`schematic`|string|yes|Canonical YAML representation used to compute the identifier.|

### `SecureBootCustomization`

Secure Boot options used when producing a Secure Boot image.

Type: object

|Property|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|`enrollKeys`|string|no|How systemd-boot enrolls Secure Boot keys on first boot; `if-safe` automatically enrolls only in a virtual machine; `force` enables unattended enrollment on bare metal; Allowed values: `off`, `manual`, `if-safe`, `force`; Default: `if-safe`.|
|`includeWellKnownCertificates`|boolean|no|Include well-known UEFI certificates in the auto-enrollment database; Default: `false`.|

### `SystemExtensions`

Official Talos system extensions to install into the image.

Type: object

|Property|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|`officialExtensions`|array<string>|no|Catalog names resolved automatically to versions compatible with Talos.|

### `VersionList`

Talos Linux versions available for image generation.

Type: array<string>

Example:

```json
[
  "v1.13.0",
  "v1.12.4"
]
```
